idea: Planning risk assessment reports for property investors and lenders
buyer: Property lenders, funds and land buyers
pain: Planning outcomes are the biggest binary risk and are assessed by instinct
v1: One planning risk report on a live site
verdict: Genuine two-domain idea but she is not a planning consultant, and that credential gap shows.

why.distribution: Both networks touch this but neither buyer is directly hers; introductions required.
why.demand: Lenders do commission planning advice, usually from planning consultants.
why.fmf: Architecture gives fluency but not planning consultancy expertise, which is its own profession with its own liability.
why.defensibility: Planning consultancies have the track record and the professional indemnity position.
why.tailwind: Planning reform is in flux, which cuts both ways.
why.ceiling: £3k x 45 sites = £135k, requiring a report volume no solo founder reaches.

ceiling_arithmetic: £3k x 45 sites = £135k. Forty-five site reports is unreachable part-time and the fee cannot rise without the planning credential. Realistic: 10-12 = £30-36k.
carries: Sits at her intersection and addresses a genuinely binary risk.
kills: Credential. Planning advice carries liability and buyers want a chartered planner.
test: Ask two lenders who they use for planning risk and what they pay.
test_pass: They describe dissatisfaction with current advisors.
test_fail: They name a planning consultancy they are happy with.
